I searched the whole repo for the word `Role`, checked for aliased imports (none), then went through each hit to separate real uses of the type from mentions in text.

**Files that name the `Role` type (22):**

- **Type definitions:** `src/types/member.ts` holds the `Role` union itself, `ROLES`, `ROLE_RANK: Record<Role, number>` and several `role: Role` fields. `src/types/feature-flag.ts`, `src/types/permission.ts` and `src/types/event.ts` import it for fields like `minRole: Role`, `targetRole: Role` and `from/to: Role`.
- **Record keyed by `Role`:** these will stop compiling until the new role gets an entry:
  - `src/lib/format.ts` (`ROLE_LABELS`)
  - `src/components/domain/permission/role-badge.tsx` (`TONE_BY_ROLE`)
  - `tests/server/_support/fixtures.ts` (`Record<Role, Actor>` / `Record<Role, UserId>`, and its own `ROLES` array)
- **`Record<PermissionAction, Role>`:** `src/lib/permissions.ts` (`ROLE_MATRIX`).
- **Imports and type annotations:**
  - `src/schemas/role.ts`, which holds the zod enum and its compile-time parity check against `Role`
  - `src/server/db/seed.ts`
  - `src/server/repositories/member-repository.ts`
  - `src/server/services/member-service.ts`
  - `src/emails/invite-email.tsx`
  - `src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/members/page.tsx`
  - `src/components/domain/member/role-select.tsx`
  - `src/components/domain/member/member-table.tsx`
  - `src/components/domain/member/invite-member-form.tsx`
- **Tests:** `tests/config/nav.test.ts`, `tests/contract/permissions.test.ts`, `tests/components/role-select.test.ts`, `tests/components/command-groups.test.ts` and `tests/lib/permissions.matrix.test.ts` import `Role`. I counted tests as source files because they're part of the TypeScript project. Leave them out if you only want application code.

**Left out:** these files contain the word "Role" but don't name the type.
- `src/types/index.ts` re-exports everything with `export *`.
- `invitation-list.tsx` only has a "Role" column header.
- `app-sidebar.tsx` and `tests/services/member-service.test.ts` only mention it in comments.
- `activity-service.ts` only has it inside a template string.
- `scripts/build-manifest.ts` and `scripts/manifest-parts/*.ts` only have it inside description strings.

ANSWER: src/types/member.ts, src/types/feature-flag.ts, src/types/permission.ts, src/types/event.ts, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/members/page.tsx, src/emails/invite-email.tsx, src/server/repositories/member-repository.ts, src/server/db/seed.ts, src/server/services/member-service.ts, src/schemas/role.ts, src/components/domain/member/role-select.tsx, src/components/domain/member/member-table.tsx, src/components/domain/member/invite-member-form.tsx, src/components/domain/permission/role-badge.tsx, src/lib/permissions.ts, src/lib/format.ts, tests/config/nav.test.ts, tests/contract/permissions.test.ts, tests/components/role-select.test.ts, tests/components/command-groups.test.ts, tests/server/_support/fixtures.ts, tests/lib/permissions.matrix.test.ts
